34166.note: Lakewood Ranch-area branch built around a trough-style raw bar with shuckers.

34430.note: US-41 branch north of the Sarasota-Bradenton airport, the oyster-bar group's first mainland spot.
34430.fn: The group says Landside opened in 1997 as its first off-island location.

34642.note: West Cortez Road branch of the local oyster-bar group with a pet-friendly patio.
34642.fn: The group says this location opened in 2002.

34732.note: Bridge Street Pier branch of the local oyster-bar group, steps from the Gulf Islands Ferry landing; its Milton-damaged dining deck was rebuilt with a new tiki in 2025.
34732.fn: The chain began in 1995 on the Anna Maria City Pier; this Bridge Street Pier location's opening year was not given.

34746.note: Dockside fish shack and market in the Cortez fishing village, supplied by the co-owned A.P. Bell Fish Co.; Helene's surge wrecked its docks and it reopened Oct. 31, 2024.
34746.seas: Stone crab claws sold in the Florida season, Oct. 15 – May 1.
34746.fn: Owner Karen Bell bought the business in 1996; no source gave its original opening year.

34758.note: Ellenton branch near I-75 and US-301, with outdoor seating over the water.
34758.fn: The group says this location opened in 2003.
